youtube_title: Pulled the Train Chain for a Missed Station? Rules You Didn't Know #23 #Shorts
youtube_description:
RULES YOU DIDN'T KNOW #23. Can you pull the train alarm chain if you miss your station? No. Under Section 141 of the Railways Act 1989, using the alarm chain without a reasonable cause can mean up to 1 year in jail, a fine up to Rs 1,000, or both, with a minimum Rs 500 fine on a first conviction.
Valid reasons: medical emergency, someone falling off the train, fire, a safety threat. Need help on a train? Call 139.
Source: Railways Act 1989, Section 141.
